Class ScenarioBundleManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioBundleManager
public class ScenarioBundleManager extends Object
Manages the unified scenario archive (.ether bundle) export, import, cryptographic verification, and UI container.

A unified bundle bundles the complete tripartite simulation state into a single signed archive:

  • Planetary astrophysics & geophysics context (Tab 1)
  • Biogeochemical & lithospheric resource distribution (Tab 2)
  • Demographic, cultural, and engine configuration (Tab 3)
